scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:unit: node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/engine.test.ts tests/environment.test.ts tests/effect-rules.test.ts tests/symbols.test.ts tests/derivation.test.ts tests/game-audio.test.ts tests/placed-sounds.test.ts tests/uwb-position.test.ts tests/uwb-bridge.test.ts tests/portals.test.ts tests/floating-world.test.ts tests/meeting.test.ts tests/meeting-whistle.test.ts tests/meeting-wire.test.ts tests/meeting-regressions.test.ts
scripts.test:meeting: node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/meeting.test.ts tests/meeting-whistle.test.ts tests/meeting-wire.test.ts tests/meeting-regressions.test.ts && playwright test tests/browser/meeting.spec.ts
scripts.test:audio: npm run audio:build && playwright test tests/browser/audio.spec.ts tests/browser/game-audio.spec.ts
scripts.test:uwb: npm run audio:build && node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/uwb-position.test.ts tests/uwb-bridge.test.ts && playwright test tests/browser/uwb.spec.ts tests/browser/uwb-live.spec.ts tests/browser/uwb-device.spec.ts
